semantics.integration_green: Canonical repository identity/integration state is explicit and no stale merge/CI blocker remains for the bounded package.
semantics.bounded_evidence_green: The currently supported bounded claim has explicit evidence and interpretation. This does not imply external validation or publication readiness.
semantics.external_science_green: External/real-data/strong-baseline scientific validation is closed for the claim. False for nearly all bounded tool/mechanics packages.
semantics.terminal_science_green: A scientific question is legitimately closed at its frozen terminal state, including negative/mixed/falsified outcomes.
